Definition: properly, to start up suddenly, i.e. (by implication) to hasten away, to fear
BiblicalUsage: 1) to hurry, flee, hasten, fear, be terrified; 1a) (Qal) to be in a hurry, be alarmed; 1b) (Niphal) to be in a hurry
